name: cc-micro-manage
description: Micro-manage your Claude Code subagents: each one, and every background shell, gets a live tmux or Ghostty pane (stacked FIFO, nested ones split their parent) with a message box to steer it, even in the background.

layout.title: Pane layout
layout.description: split: subagent panes stack in a column beside Claude. window: they tile in a separate "agents" tmux window.

linger.title: Seconds a pane stays after its agent finishes
linger.description: How long a finished agent's pane stays open so you can read its result. -1 keeps it open until you press Enter.

message_shortcut.title: Message shortcut
message_shortcut.description: Key after your tmux prefix that opens a message prompt for the focused subagent pane. "none" disables it. A binding that isn't ours is never overwritten.

relay.title: Relay messages to background subagents
relay.description: When you message a background subagent, type a one-line SendMessage request into Claude's input box for you (only while it's empty). Off makes background panes read-only.

borders.title: Pane border titles
borders.description: Turn on tmux pane-border titles (agent purpose and a status dot) in windows with agent panes, if you haven't enabled borders yourself.

shells.title: Panes for background shells
shells.description: Give each background shell (a Bash command Claude runs in the background, like a dev server or a test watcher) its own pane streaming its output, until it exits or is stopped.

skip.title: Agent types to ignore
skip.description: Comma-separated subagent types that never get a pane, e.g. Explore,statusline-setup
